text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was about to eat in the cafeteria, I 
overheard a conversation between Mejiro 
Bright and Fine Motion nearby.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: An email from a prince?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It arrived addressed to me this 
morning, saying, "I am a prince of a 
certain nation."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, they have so much extra money 
that they're looking for someone to put it 
to good use~."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, charity work? But would royalty 
really send an email like that?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So, did you reply?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I can't just accept money from a 
stranger, so I told them, "No thank you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then I received another message, saying 
the prince had gotten into an accident...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: My, what incredible timing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"And so they got injured, and apparently 
need financial help for the medical 
treatment."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? But shouldn't that person have 
plenty of money to spare?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I heard all the money burned up in an 
accident.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you had the entire amount in cash...? 
And for it all to burn down, that must 
have been a huge fire, but I haven't seen 
any news about—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Unable to stay silent any longer, I 
decided to join the conversation."
choice_data_list: All of that is a lie.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Is that so...?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no wonder it sounded too good to be 
true! The prince part, the getting hurt in 
an accident part— was all of that made up, 
I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Was that so! Well, that is such a 
relief~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So nobody was involved in an accident~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she was almost deceived, 
Mejiro Bright breathes a sigh of relief.
choice_data_list:
Maybe I still have a lot to learn about 
the world...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You suddenly said there was an accident, 
so I was worried sick without stopping to 
think~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, unfortunately, there are people out 
there who try to take advantage of such 
good intentions... Let's both be careful, 
Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Understood~ Thank you very much for the 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's a lesson in the ways of the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If only there were an easy way to tell 
whether an email is fake or not.
choice_data_list: Just ignore all emails from strangers.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see! So I should rethink my habit of 
trying to read through every single thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the advice. I shall be 
careful from now on~
choice_data_list:
Let's change the email address if 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're right! It'd be troublesome if that 
person claiming to be a prince contacted 
me again, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Understood~ ...So, what's this about 
changing your address?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I'm so sorry! My bodyguards always 
do everything for me, so I have no idea~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up helping Mejiro Bright 
change her email address.
